messages.text:
Here they are on the US average of 17 cents a kWh, BTC at $83,349 today. Tell me your state (or your rate) and I'll rerun it for your place.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650 W, about $20 per TH:
stacks ~57,320 sats a month, worth about $47.78 today. Power runs ~$80.62 a month. Break-even BTC price is $140,649. Solo block jackpot is ~$261,906, odds about 1 in 164,985 a day, 0.22% over a year.

So at 17 cents it's stacking sats plus a lottery ticket, not profit. Under about 9 cents it flips positive. It's Batch 5, ships November 14.
So if I bought 4 of them what would it cost to run a day, not worried about the profit at this point

About $10.60 a day at 17 cents, so roughly $322 a month. That's 2.6 kW running flat out, 62.4 kWh a day.

Worth knowing: four of them on one 15A/120V circuit won't fly. You'd want them split across circuits, or on 240V.

Give me your state and I'll redo the daily cost at your real rate, since 17 cents is just the national average.
British Columbia Canada, electric is included with my rent

Then your running cost is zero, which changes everything. Four 40Ts stack about 229,280 sats a month, worth roughly $191 at today's price, with no power bill against it. Jackpot odds go to about 1 in 41,000 a day, near 0.9% over a year.

With free power the 40T is the right pick, best sats per dollar we sell. Two things to check with a rental: 2.6 kW is real heat, and four units are audible, so not a bedroom.

Want me to put four in a cart? Batch 5, ships November 14.

Close. Four at $799 is $3,196 USD, so roughly $4,300 to $4,500 CAD depending on the day's rate, plus shipping and any BC sales tax added at checkout. No import duty or VAT into Canada.

Note the listing: 40 TH/s at 650 W is the middle mode. Turbo gives you 50 TH/s at 850 W, Eco 30 TH/s at 450 W. With free power you'd run Turbo, so figure 200 TH/s across four.
